class.name: SuperpositionRPC
class.brief_description: Allowlisted reliable remote calls for spawned gameplay objects.
class.description: Dispatches explicitly allowlisted reliable RPCs for scenes managed by [SuperpositionSpawner]. Set [member spawner_path] and add matching [SuperpositionRPCMethod] resources. The receiver verifies scene and method fingerprints, live target identity, sender permission, exact arguments and rates. Dispatch is deferred out of the transport callback and revalidates identity and schema, so queued messages cannot retarget a despawned instance or replacement session. The queue holds at most 256 calls and limits aggregate incoming calls to 128 per peer per second. RPCs do not provide automatic gameplay authorization or prediction.

method.name: get_method_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the digest of the complete ordered allowlist, including IDs, method names, permissions, argument types and rate limits. Peers must match this digest before dispatch.

method.name: get_spawner
method.description: Returns the configured spawner while inside the scene tree, or null when the path is invalid.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns sent, received and rejected counters, pending dispatch count and the latest diagnostic. Counters are local to this RPC node.

method.name: send_rpc
method.description: Queues an allowlisted method call for a live membership [param entity]. [param arguments] must exactly match the method schema. Clients send to the server; servers use -1 to broadcast to compatible peers or a live [param peer] to target one recipient. Returns [constant OK] when queued, not when dispatched or acknowledged. A broadcast can partially enqueue before a later recipient fails; avoid blindly retrying non-idempotent effects.

members.member: One to 64 explicit method resources. IDs and names must be unique, and the complete schema must match across peers.
Path to the [SuperpositionSpawner] that supplies the session, live entity mapping and authenticated ownership checks.

signal.name: rpc_dispatched
signal.description: Emitted after invoking an allowed target method. Identifies the sending peer, membership entity and method ID; it does not acknowledge an outbound call.

signal.name: rpc_error
signal.description: Emitted when configuration, sending, permission, validation, rate limiting or dispatch fails.
